method: Each claim checked against the retrieved text of the ASHM donovanosis page. Doses, durations and intervals compared character by character. RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-22: the page in retrieved_from was fetched again and every claim attributed to this source was re-checked against it. Quotes stored from the earlier scrape carried that scrape's table and list markup (pipes, numbered list markers) into the quoted string; each was replaced with the text the page actually carries, located by alignment against the retrieved copy (scripts/repair_quotes.py). No dose, duration or concentration changed: the set of numbers in every repaired quote was compared before and after, and the only difference across 156 repaired quotes was list numerals 1-4 becoming bullets. Where a reference superscript falls inside a quoted sentence the page renders it inline, so it appears in source_text; it is part of the retrieved text, not part of the assertion.

claims.claim: In non-healing genital lesions, carcinoma needs to be considered
claims.source_text: In non-healing genital lesions, carcinoma needs to be considered.

claims.claim: Neoplastic transformation is possible
claims.source_text: Neoplastic transformation is possible.

claims.claim: Biopsy if there is any concern about malignant change
claims.source_text: Biopsy if any concern about malignant change.

claims.claim: Recurrence of lesions may represent development of skin cancer in previous lesions and requires biopsy
claims.source_text: Recurrence of lesions may represent development of skin cancer in previous lesions and requires biopsy.

claims.claim: NAAT on a dry swab or punch biopsy is highly sensitive and specific but only available at Pathwest laboratories in WA and the Molecular Diagnostics Unit at Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital; discuss with the laboratory before sending the specimen
claims.source_text: Dry swab or punch biopsy of lesions NAAT Highly sensitive and specific but only available in Pathwest laboratories in WA and the Molecular Diagnostics Unit at Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital. Discuss with your laboratory before sending specimen

claims.claim: Histology on punch biopsy has low-to-moderate sensitivity but is highly specific and requires an experienced histopathologist as classic Donovan bodies may be sparse
claims.source_text: Punch biopsy of lesion Histology Low-to-moderate sensitivity but highly specific; requires experienced histopathologist as classic Donovan bodies may be sparse

claims.claim: Seek specialist advice before treating this rare condition
claims.source_text: Seek specialist advice before treating this rare condition.

claims.claim: Anogenital lesions: azithromycin 500 mg PO daily for 7 days, or azithromycin 1 g PO once weekly for at least 4 weeks until complete resolution of lesions
claims.source_text: Anogenital lesions Azithromycin 500 mg PO, daily for 7 days OR Azithromycin 1 g PO, once weekly for at least 4 weeks, until complete resolution of lesions

claims.claim: The alternative is doxycycline 100 mg PO BD for a minimum of 4 weeks until complete resolution of lesions
claims.source_text: Doxycycline 100 mg PO, BD for a minimum of 4 weeks, until complete resolution of lesions

claims.claim: Azithromycin is highly effective and well tolerated
claims.source_text: Azithromycin is highly effective and well tolerated.

claims.claim: Azithromycin is the recommended treatment in pregnant people
claims.source_text: Pregnant people Azithromycin is the recommended treatment

claims.claim: Many guidelines recommend treating with azithromycin until lesions have completely healed but there is no evidence that longer treatment is beneficial, while non-azithromycin regimens should be continued until complete resolution of lesions
claims.source_text: Many guidelines recommend treating with azithromycin until lesions have completely healed but there is no evidence that longer treatment is beneficial. Non-azithromycin regimens should be continued until complete resolution of lesions.

claims.claim: Adherence to treatment is essential to ensure cure and directly-observed therapy should be considered
claims.source_text: Adherence to treatment is essential to ensure cure, consider directly-observed therapy.

claims.claim: Patients may require hospital admission if adherence to treatment is poor or disseminated disease is present
claims.source_text: Patients may require hospital admission if adherence to treatment is poor or disseminated disease present.

claims.claim: Advise no sexual contact for 7 days after treatment is commenced, or until the course is completed and symptoms resolved, whichever is later
claims.source_text: Advise no sexual contact for 7 days after treatment is commenced, or until the course is completed and symptoms resolved, whichever is later.

claims.claim: Advise no sex with partners from the last 6 months until the partners have been reviewed and treated if necessary
claims.source_text: Advise no sex with partners from the last 6 months until the partners have been reviewed and treated if necessary.

claims.claim: Notify the state or territory health department, and the auditable outcome is that 100% of diagnoses are notified
claims.source_text: Notify the state or territory health department. ... 100% of diagnoses are notified to the state or territory health departments.

claims.claim: Donovanosis is primarily sexually transmissible but may be transmitted vertically and by casual contact
claims.source_text: Primarily sexually transmissible but may be transmitted vertically and by casual contact.

claims.claim: Vertical transmission to a neonate can occur during vaginal delivery
claims.source_text: Vertical transmission to neonate during vaginal delivery.

claims.claim: Neonates born to a mother with untreated donovanosis at time of delivery should be followed closely for the development of lesions
claims.source_text: Neonates born to a mother with untreated donovanosis at time of delivery should be followed closely for the development of lesions.

claims.claim: Donovanosis presents as relatively painless anogenital ulceration
claims.source_text: Relatively painless anogenital ulceration

claims.claim: Lesions may be ulcerative with shallow ulcers which bleed on contact, proliferative with raised beefy lesions, or ulcero-proliferative
claims.source_text: ulcerative: shallow ulcers which bleed on contact - proliferative: raised lesions with a beefy appearance - ulcero-proliferative: a combination of the two

claims.claim: Lesions may involve the genitals, perineum and perianal area, and secondary anaerobic bacterial infection may result in offensive odour
claims.source_text: Lesions may involve the genitals, perineum and perianal area. - Secondary anaerobic bacterial infection may result in offensive odour in association with the primary lesions

claims.claim: Extra-genital disease is uncommon but may occur via auto-inoculation, contiguous spread such as to uterus and fallopian tubes, or haematogenous spread such as to long bones and psoas muscle
claims.source_text: Extra-genital disease is uncommon but may occur via auto-inoculation, contiguous spread (e.g. uterus, fallopian tubes) or haematogenous spread (e.g. long bones, psoas muscle).

claims.claim: Chronic untreated ulcers may lead to lymphatic destruction with subsequent pseudo-elephantiasis of the genitalia
claims.source_text: Chronic, untreated ulcers may lead to lymphatic destruction with subsequent pseudo-elephantiasis of genitalia.

claims.claim: Donovanosis increases HIV transmission risk
claims.source_text: Increase in human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) transmission risk.

claims.claim: Extra-genital disease should be considered in patients with current genital infection and in patients with a past history of donovanosis who present with unusual symptoms
claims.source_text: Extra-genital disease should be considered in patients with current genital infection and in patients with a past history of donovanosis who present with unusual symptoms

claims.claim: Complicated or disseminated infection may require prolonged treatment
claims.source_text: Complicated or disseminated infection May require prolonged treatment

claims.claim: Donovanosis is a rare cause of genital ulceration but should be considered in patients returning from endemic areas such as PNG, Southern Africa, India and parts of South America
claims.source_text: Donovanosis is a rare cause of genital ulceration but should be considered in patients returning from areas where the disease may be endemic e.g. PNG, Southern Africa, India and parts of South America.

claims.claim: Incident cases were found as recently as the mid 2000s in northern and tropical Australia among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people but it is now very rare in these areas
claims.source_text: Incident cases were found as recently as mid 2000s in northern and tropical Australia among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, but it is now very rare in these areas.

claims.claim: Contact tracing of sexual partners in the last 6 months is recommended but yield is low
claims.source_text: Contact tracing of sexual partners in last 6 months is recommended but yield is low.

claims.claim: Review in 1 week to confirm adherence and symptom resolution, confirm contact tracing, and educate about condoms, contraception, HIV PrEP/PEP, safe injecting, consent, cervical screening and HAV, HBV and HPV vaccination
claims.source_text: Review in 1 week provides an opportunity to: - Confirm patient adherence with treatment and assess for symptom resolution - Confirm contact tracing has been undertaken or offer more contact tracing support - Educate about condom use, contraception, HIV PrEP/PEP, safe injecting practices, consent, CST and vaccinations for HAV, HBV and HPV as indicated

claims.claim: Relapse and re-infection can occur and patients should be reviewed at completion of the treatment course and at 3 months
claims.source_text: Relapse and re-infection can occur and patients should be reviewed at completion of treatment course and at 3 months

claims.claim: Retesting is not required but provides an opportunity to retest post the window period for other STIs if not undertaken at first presentation
claims.source_text: Not required but provides the opportunity to retest, post the window period, for other STIs, if not undertaken at first presentation.

claims.claim: Donovanosis is caused by Klebsiella granulomatis
claims.source_text: Klebsiella granulomatis
